source: Real Windows UI Automation from a separate Electron fixture; no synthetic selection hooks, clipboard writes, or external services.
limitation: Equivalent embedded-web desktop scenarios; this test does not automate or certify the ChatGPT application.

cases.name: Document selection with a focused button
Identical text in a different paragraph updates the selection
Clearing selection invalidates the cached document
Empty composer caret does not show the toolbar
Cross-site embedded document with a focused child button
Clearing an embedded selection invalidates it
Outer document can be selected again
Toolbar content reappears after clearing and reselecting
No stale selection after leaving the password field
